entry.title: Roseburg City Council to Revisit Flock Camera Decision Monday Following Weeks of Debate
entry.summary: Roseburg City Council will revisit its Flock license plate reader cameras Monday, November 9, following weeks of debate over privacy, public safety, and oversight. A postponed motion to maintain the city's existing 15-camera system is scheduled for consideration.

entry.title: Roseburg Reports Nearly $120,000 in Homelessness-Related Response Costs for September
entry.summary: Roseburg documented $119,994 in estimated homelessness-related resource costs during September, including 955 staff hours and 103 fire responses. The new City Council report details where resources were used and how September compares with July.

entry.title: Rain Returns to Roseburg Monday Before Warmer Weather Arrives, Wetter Pattern Possible This Weekend
entry.summary: Rain returns to Roseburg Monday with highs near 60 before warmer, mostly dry weather arrives Tuesday through Thursday. Veterans Day could reach 68 degrees, but forecasters are watching a potentially wetter and windier pattern developing this weekend.
